parameters.name: URL
parameters.description: The {{datatype}} for the collection server to receive the Bulk Data transmitted by the CPE.

parameters.name: Username
parameters.description: Username used to authenticate the CPE when making a connection to the collection server.

parameters.name: Password
parameters.description: Password used to authenticate the CPE when making a connection to the collection server.

parameters.name: CompressionsSupported
parameters.description: Indicates the HTTP Compression mechanism(s) supported by this CPE for the purposes of transferring bulk data.

parameters.name: Compression
parameters.description: The value of this parameter represents the HTTP Compression mechanism to be used by the CPE when transferring data to the collection server.

parameters.name: MethodsSupported
parameters.description: Indicates the HTTP method(s) supported by this CPE for the purposes of transferring bulk data.

parameters.name: Method
parameters.description: The value of this parameter represents the HTTP method to be used by the CPE when transferring data to the collection server.

parameters.name: UseDateHeader
parameters.description: When {{true}}, the CPE encodes the HTTP Date Header {{bibref|RFC2616|Section 14.18}} in the HTTP client request.

parameters.name: RetryEnable
parameters.description: When {{true}}, the CPE retries unsuccessful attempts to transfer data.

parameters.name: RetryMinimumWaitInterval
parameters.description: Configures the data transfer retry wait interval, in seconds, as specified in {{template|BULK-DATA-HTTP-RETRY-REF}}. The device MUST use a random value between {{param}} and ({{param}} * {{param|RetryIntervalMultiplier}} / 1000) as the first retry wait interval. Other values in the retry pattern MUST be calculated using this value as a starting point.

parameters.name: RetryIntervalMultiplier
parameters.description: Configures the retry interval multiplier as specified in {{template|BULK-DATA-HTTP-RETRY-REF}}. This value is expressed in units of 0.001. Hence the values of the multiplier range between 1.000 and 65.535. The device MUST use a random value between {{param|RetryMinimumWaitInterval}} and ({{param|RetryMinimumWaitInterval}} * {{param}} / 1000) as the first retry wait interval. Other values in the retry pattern MUST be calculated using this value as a starting point.

parameters.name: PersistAcrossReboot
parameters.description: Determines whether or not data transfers that have failed are required to be persisted across reboots. If {{param}} is {{true}}, then failed data transfers MUST be persisted across reboots. If {{param}} is {{false}}, then failed data transfers are not required to be persisted across reboots.

object.description: This object defines the properties to be used when transporting bulk data using the HTTP/HTTPS protocol. This object is used when the {{param|#.Protocol}} parameter has a value of {{enum|HTTP|##.Protocols}}. For authentication purposes the CPE MUST support HTTP Basic and Digest Access Authentication as defined in {{bibref|RFC7617}} and {{bibref|RFC7616}}.
